$$
    W = \frac{(\sum_{i = 1}^n a_i x_{(i)})^2}{\sum_{i = 1}^n (x_i - \bar{x})^2}
$${#eq-shapiro}
$$
    D_n = \sup_x |F_n(x) - F(x)|
$${#eq-kolmogorov}
$$
    D_{n, m} = \sup_x |F_n(x) - D_m(x)|
$${#eq-kolmogorov-2D}


$$
    F_n(x)  = \frac{1}{n} \text{number}[x_i < x]
$${#eq-kolmogorov-fn}

$$
    \text{Levene based on F stat}
$${#eq-levene}

$$
    \text{Bartlett based on likelihood ratio test}
$${#eq-bartlett}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{ s/ \sqrt{n}}
$${#eq-t-test}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{ \hat{\sigma}/ \sqrt{n}}
$${#eq-t-test-2}


$$
    F = \frac{MS_{Treatments}}{MS_{Error}} = \frac{\frac{\sum_j^k n_j (\bar{X_j} - \bar{X})^2}{k - 1}}{\frac{\sum_j \sum (X - \bar{X_j})^2}{N - k}}
$${#eq-anova}

$$
    y \sim N(a x + b, \sigma^2)
$${#eq-lm}

$$
    q_s = \frac{|Y_A - Y_B|}{ \hat{\sigma}/ \sqrt{n}}
$${#eq-tukey}
$$
    p_i \leq \frac{\alpha}{m}
$${#eq-bonferroni}

$$
    p_k \leq \frac{\alpha}{ m + 1 - k}
$${#eq-holm}
$$
    p_i \leq 1 - (1 - \alpha)^{1/m}
$${#eq-sidak}
$$
    \text{Permutation anova}
$${#eq-permutation}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{X_A} - \bar{X_B}}{\sqrt{\frac{s_A^2}{N_A} + \frac{s_B^2}{N_B}}}
$${#eq-welch}
$$
    H = (N - 1) \frac{\sum_{i = 1}^g n_i(\bar{r_{i.}} - \bar{r})^2}{\sum_{i = 1}^g \sum_{j = 1}^{n_i} (r_{ij} - \bar{r})^2}
$${#eq-kruskal}

$$
    \text{Wilocoxon}
$${#eq-wilcox}
